# 🛠️ Pull Request Template

## Description

Please include a summary of the change and the related issue. Mention any motivation or context.  
Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

Check the relevant option(s):

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix  
- [ ] ✨ New feature  
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update  
- [ ] 🧹 Code style / refactor  
- [ ] 🧪 Tests added or updated  
- [ ] 🔧 CI/CD configuration

## Checklist

Before submitting, make sure you’ve done the following:

- [ ] I’ve read the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I’ve written or updated tests as needed  
- [ ] I’ve run `dart format` to ensure code style  
- [ ] All CI checks pass  
- [ ] I’ve updated related documentation (README, comments, etc.)

## Screenshots (if applicable)

Include screenshots or screen recordings to show visual changes.

## Additional Notes

Add any extra context, edge cases, or known limitations.

---

Thanks for improving **EVE Frontier**! 🛰️ We review PRs within a few days and will comment if anything needs attention.
